annotations.title: Collect the result of a website scan

description: Collect the result of a scan that scan_website started but had not finished when it answered. Call scan_website first; if its status is "processing", wait a little (about 30 seconds) and call this with the scanId it returned. Returns the same result as scan_website: "processing" (ask again shortly), "ready" (the 0-100 score and top issues) or "failed". It only reads: it never starts a scan. A scanId stops working 7 days after it was issued.

scanId.description: The scanId that scan_website returned with status "processing".

waitSeconds.description: Optional: how many seconds to wait for a scan that is still running before answering (0-20, default 0 = answer now).

name: get_scan_result

findings.description: The top issues to fix first, most urgent first.

note.description: Plain-language context about the score and the full report to come.

scanId.description: Present while status is "processing": pass it to get_scan_result to collect the finished result.

score.description: 0-100 online-presence score, or null until the quick pass finishes.

status.description: "ready" = quick score below; "processing" = still running, report follows; "failed" = site could not be checked.

whatsapp.description: A WhatsApp link to reach the Kashif team about this business.

title: Collect the result of a website scan
